svg.title: About me
svg.desc: I’m Justin. I like building small tools that take friction out of everyday work. When I’m deep in a coding session, I want the tools I use to help me keep my train of thought. I also like experimenting with how work feels on screen. This little desktop is one of those experiments. I wanted my profile to feel like sitting down and showing you what I’ve been working on.
